articles.title: IBM opens beta Swift ledger link for 24/7 tokenized deposits
articles.snippet: IBM’s beta link lets banks instruct tokenized deposit transfers on Swift’s ledger using existing payment messages and compliance processes.

articles.title: Meta's New AI Toy Is a Keychain That Watches, Listens, and Never Blinks
articles.snippet: Muse Charm is Meta's palm-sized gadget for talking to its Muse AI agent on the go. It has cameras, a fingerprint sensor, and its own cell connection.

articles.title: New York Wants to Ban Polymarket, Lawsuit Calls It 'Illegal Gambling Operation'
articles.snippet: Attorney General Letitia James and Governor Kathy Hochul allege the prediction market operates without a license and exposes New Yorkers to gambling harms.

articles.title: OpenAI Gives Ukraine Access to Daybreak AI Cyber-Defense Tool
articles.snippet: OpenAI is giving Ukraine's government access to Daybreak, its AI vulnerability-hunting system, as the country's cyber defenders face a record wave of attacks on hospitals, power grids, and government networks.

articles.title: Former Polish Police Officer Charged as Zondacrypto Probe Searches Fuel Depot
articles.snippet: Investigators are combing the site where the exchange's founder was last seen in 2022, using experts and forensic equipment.
